name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
summary: A supported unilateral row that lets you load each side of the back with a long range of motion and minimal lower-back demand.
setup: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a flat bench, or one hand on the bench with the other foot back.
Keep the back flat and roughly parallel to the floor.
Hold the dumbbell with a neutral grip and arm hanging straight below the shoulder.
execution: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the shoulder blade toward the spine at the top.
Lower until the arm is straight and the shoulder blade stretches forward.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
cues: Chest and hips square to the floor
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift: keep the shoulders level and use a lighter weight.
Pulling straight up to the chest: row toward the hip in a slight arc.
Rounding the back: keep the spine long and the head in line with it.
Short range of motion: stretch fully at the bottom before each pull.
